title: chai2010/gettext-go
notes: Gettexter.Gettext(msgid) or NGettext(msgid, plural, n) from gettext.New over an in-memory zip of the .mo; fmt.Sprintf fills the placeholders.
details: The library picks the plural rule from the catalog's Language header, not from Plural-Forms, so the catalogs carry a Language header, as msginit writes one. The zip is built and the locale set in prepare, which loads the catalog.
